data.one_liner: Stack widget that animates adding and removing children
data.what_it_does: The package provides an AnimatedStack widget that lets you add or remove children with a smooth animation, similar to AnimatedList but for a Stack. It exposes an AnimatedStackManager to control the stack programmatically.
use_when: You need to animate the appearance or disappearance of widgets in a Stack layout
You want a lightweight solution without external dependencies
avoid_when: You require complex animation curves or physics-based motion beyond simple fade/slide
You need a maintained, actively developed package
weaknesses: Last release was 2021, no recent maintenance
No support for advanced animation features
